Monday, the 15th day of January 2024 / 25th Pousha, 1945  CRL.M.APPL.NO.1/2023 IN CRL.A NO. 441 OF 2023  SC 317/2018 OF FAST TRACK SPECIAL COURT,IDUKKI,PAINAVU PETITIONER/APPELLANT:
 XXX RESPONDENT/RESPONDENT:
 STATE OF KERALA REPRESENTED BY PUBLIC PROSECUTOR,HIGH COURT OF  KERALA, PIN - 682031  Application praying that in the circumstances stated therein the High Court be pleased to suspend the conviction and sentence passed against the petitioner on 17.01.2023 in S.C.317/2018 of the Special Court under PoCSO Act , Idukki ,Painavu pending the above Criminal Appeal.

This Application coming on for orders upon perusing the application and upon hearing the arguments of SRI.M.V.RAJENDRAN NAIR, Advocate for the petitioner and of the PUBLIC PROSECUTOR for the respondent, the court passed the following:
 p.t.o  SOPHY THOMAS, J.
 -----------------------------------------------------------
 Crl.Appeal No.441 of 2023  -----------------------------------------------------------
Dated this the 15th day of January, 2024

ORDER This is an application for suspension of sentence filed by the appellant who stands convicted by the Fast Track Special Court, Idukki, Painavu, for offences punishable under Sections 376(2)n, 376(2)f and 376(2)i of the Indian Penal Code, and Sections 5(j)ii, 5(n), 5(p) and 5(l)R r/w Section 6 of the Xxx vs State Of Kerala on 15 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/129855503/
1 Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act.

entities.text: Fast Track Special Court, Idukki, Painavu
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: He was sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for a period of ten years and to pay Rs.25,000/- as fine, IDSI for one year for the offence under Section 5(l) r/w 6 of POCSO Act.
He is further sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for a period of ten years and to pay Rs.25,000/- as fine, IDSI for one year for the offence under Section 5(j)ii r/w 6 of POCSO Act.

He is also sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for a period of ten years and to pay Rs.25,000/- as fine, IDSI for one year for the offence under Section 5(n) r/w 6 of POCSO Act, and also sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for a period of ten years and to pay Rs.25,000/- as fine, IDSI for one year for the offence under Section 5(p) r/w 6 of the POCSO Act.
The substantive sentences were directed to run concurrently.

2. Learned Public Prosecutor filed objection, stating that, the petitioner/appellant is none other than the step father of the victim girl aged 15, and he was continuously subjecting the child to penetrative sexual assault, and as a result, she became pregnant, and later, she was subjected to abortion.

Considering the gravity of the offence committed, learned Public Prosecutor would submit that, the petitioner/appellant is not entitled to get his sentence suspended, or to get bail, as the safety and security of the victim girl will be affected by his release.
3. A little girl aged 15 was sexually exploited continuously by her step father, and she became pregnant, and later, her pregnancy was aborted.
During DNA test, it was found that, the appellant/petitioner was the father of the child conceived by the victim girl.
That also is the serious circumstance which stands proved against him.
4. In this factual scenario, this Court is of the view that, this is not a fit case to suspend his sentence and to release him on bail.
Moreover, as he stands convicted, there shall not be any presumption of innocence, as it was held by the Apex Court in Preet Pal Singh v. State of Uttar Pradesh and Another; [(2020) 8 SCC 645].

entities.text: Preet Pal Singh v. State of Uttar Pradesh and Another; [(2020) 8 SCC 645]
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the absence of any strong and compelling reason which tempts this Court for granting bail, this Court is not inclined to suspend his sentence and to release him on bail.
In the result, Crl.M.A.No.1 of 2023 stands dismissed.
Crl.Appeal Posted to 21.05.2024.

Sd/-
SOPHY THOMAS JUDGE rkj 15-01-2024
